build.buildCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @workspace/ep-app build && pnpm --filter @workspace/admin build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm -C lib/db exec drizzle-kit push --force --config drizzle.config.ts && node --enable-source-maps ./artifacts/api-server/dist/index.mjs
